title: TikTok staff raised child safety concerns, but executives reportedly failed to act | TechCrunch
summary: According to NPR, TikTok employees warned that minors were appearing in sexual content that was available for purchase on TikTok, raising concerns that the company could profit from potentially illegal activity.
